name: Journey: an item asks for the journey's level and carries the item level of that level
contract: Requires mod-coa-content-scaling with CoAContentScaling.Enable=1, Progression.Mode=Journey, TBC.Enable=1 and WotLK.Enable=1 at the default journey shape, and CoA.CreatureScaling.Enable=0 (conf/verify-all-scaling.json). Dirigible Crash Helmet (25981, Outland green, required level 60, item level 87) was made for 60 and becomes required level Outland(60) = 33, item level 87 x 38 / 94.17 = 35. Benevolent Hood (35814, Northrend green, 68, item level 138) was made for 70 and becomes Northrend(70) = 43, item level 138 x 48 / 139.5 = 47. Idol of the Ferocious (1550, epic, 60, item level 70) is a reward of the old world's raids and stays as it is. Added items carry no native scaling level, so their own templates are read.

steps.label: The old world's raid reward stays at 60
